causalConclusion: Known hosted missing-return/marker-loss failure did not reproduce. All nine actions in each local iteration have outer pan began/ended and interacting sequences. This does not establish the hosted failure cause.
timingLimit: Epoch aligns observation records with XCTest activity timestamps; samples are processing-time snapshots, not actual touch delivery or main-thread-duration measurements. Polls may miss short intervals; instrumentation adds work.
routingLimit: Hit-test ancestry is potential routing at snapshot time. New successful-run synthesized-event files/video/AX artifacts were not retained by original generated lifetime defaults. Current actual injected window paths therefore are not independently archived; normalized action titles and native-derived/fixed-host endpoint comparison are retained.
